company.name: Waza
company.shortDescription: Waza is a B2B payments platform and liquidity provider for emerging market businesses.
company.description: Waza is a web platform with APIs. It helps startups and emerging market businesses manage their cash flow issues, invoicing needs, and international payment requirements.

productsAndServices.description: Enables businesses in emerging markets to send and receive payments in USD, EUR, and GBP with 24/7 access to foreign currency.
productsAndServices.name: Multi-Currency Payments

productsAndServices.description: Offers multiple payment options including Waza balance, debit cards, e-wallets, and bank transfers for global payments.
productsAndServices.name: Payment Channels

productsAndServices.description: Provides an easy-to-use dashboard with reporting and reconciliation features for managing payments and cross-border invoices.
productsAndServices.name: Dashboard and Reporting

productsAndServices.description: Allows businesses to create invoices customized to their brand and supports multi-currency billing.
productsAndServices.name: Customizable Invoicing

productsAndServices.description: Provides working capital by financing unpaid invoices to improve cash flow for businesses.
productsAndServices.name: Invoice Financing (Beta)

productsAndServices.description: Enables businesses to pay in their local currency to simplify cross-border transactions and avoid currency exchange issues.
productsAndServices.name: Local Currency Payments

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Debt Financing round raised $5,000,000, or 58% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,902,948 to $17,101,474, a 4.38x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 53 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 62 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Checkout.com, dLocal, Incode Technologies.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
